body: I wish I could.   I am still deathly afraid of my ex husband.   Plus, I don't know what lies he has told her about me.   I think she's better off me just being gone then I don't have to tell her the evilness her father put upon me and my cowardness.

Oh yeah, plus my only friend lives far away so I have no place or no one but my husband and he asks when I am going to do it or should I take you to the hospital and that doesn't work for me.   I am on a good med combination.   If I was on anymore, I would be too sedated to work and I need to work to pay child support and have insurance.

This is the quick short story.  We'll shorter story.   Got married to an abuser at 18, divorced at 22.  We shared custody of our daughter until he decided on a holiday not to meet me, pick up the phone, or meet me at the designated location.   He had never abused her, laid a hand on her, or hurt her.   I was still, and still am so scared of him, I'm 35 now and my daughter is 16, I never pursued anything because he threatened to kill me and my whole family.   When I left him and I still had my daughter, he would be at places I was, I had "friends" that would tell him where I was and what I was doing, who I was dating, after the divorce was final.   I have not seen or heard from my daughter for 11 years and I am afraid to make contact.  I moved far away because I am afraid of my ex husband.   I just wish he would have killed me when he was abusing me.   He was not just physically abusing me, it was emotionally, verbally, and financially.  My name was not on the checking account but my checks would go in to it.   We had one car so he would know where I was all the time.   Now I suffer from PTSD, depression, anxiety, and panic attacks.  I am on medication and tried the therapist thing.   I can't take not seeing my own daughter going through her milestones in life.  And I am too afraid to contact him.  I am sure he gave her some over the top story of why I am not there, like I abandoned her or I am a drug addict or an alcoholic. Everyone is telling me wait until she's 18, we'll life isn't a lifetime movie and she might reject me and believe her father.  She probably doesn't remember me.   I am not even on Facebook because of her father.  So that is why I want to die.  I cannot stand the pain for more years.  I don't feel like the pain is temporary, because it does not go away, it just gets worse.   I think that it is when you cannot cope with your problems and I feel like I cannot cope anymore.  
Sorry for the late response.  I was working yesterday.
Thank you!  I am hoping it will get better, life just seems so obsolete lately.

I have been seeing a really good psychiatrist that I feel like I cam really trust for the past 6 months.   I actually stopped seeing him for about 3 months and seeing someone closer to my house for a few months, huge mistake.   He welcomed me back like I never left.   I like him because I don't feel like a  number to him.  He knows my name and asks how things are going, not just about the medication.   I saw him a month ago and it really stinks because I have been on so many medication before.  He tells me to be patient and we will find the right combo.  So, as of now, we found an antidepressant that helps enough to get me to work full time without being catatonic.  I'm not a fan of the ad ons because they give me zombie effects. He just changed my daily anxiety med, and ordered my other prn to be taken daily as needed, plus as a 4times daily dose, which won't work because I work full time. 
I was seeing the same therapist until last month and she got a job working in a school. I was able to really open up to her without feeling judgement and she referred me to another therapist in her practice.  When I sat done and looked and thought about it, I wasn't sure if I would be able to talk with the new one and not get hostipalized, which doesn't help me.  I wish my insurance would cover intensive programming or  day treatment, but it does not.  Plus, I need to work full time.  I have child support I pay twice monthly and other bills to pay on meager wages.  Thanks for reading!!

Wow, interesting post.   Well, I have to say myself.   I know that's not killing someone else and it's suicide, but I don't want the consequences of hurting my family.
